REMOTE RISK CHECK — PROJECT SUMMARY

Author: Alessio Carrà
Target role: Senior Product Manager, Fraud and Compliance at Remote
Format: Independent, synthetic, working product exploration
Live demo: https://bralca.github.io/remote-risk-check/?case=reserve-required
Source: https://github.com/bralca/remote-risk-check

Risk Check asks one question: Should Remote let this company hire?

The one-page product demonstrates:
- An AI-assisted employer investigation brief grounded in structured evidence.
- Deterministic, configurable rules for credit risk, KYB, and reserve decisions.
- Clear separation between facts, AI recommendations, and human-approved actions.
- A balanced-versus-strict policy tradeoff that exposes false-positive risk.
- Customer-facing explanations that do not reveal sensitive control logic.
- A server-side adapter for signed, timestamped Remote-shaped webhooks.

The public demo uses three fictional employer cases and contains no real customer,
employee, applicant, or Remote proprietary data. It requires no login or API key.

AI boundary:
AI summarizes evidence, identifies missing information, and recommends an action.
The deterministic policy calculates status. A human approves consequential actions.

Relevant product experience:
- 12+ years across product, platform, APIs, and growth.
- Built API products at Moralis from zero to $10M ARR in nine months.
- Led growth work at Celsius and Pipe, including revenue growth outcomes.
- Builds functional AI-assisted products with Codex, agents, routing, and evaluations.

Important terms:
AI, automation, fraud and compliance, credit risk, reserve management, KYB, AML,
background checks, operational tooling, APIs, false-positive reduction, risk accuracy,
human-in-the-loop systems, evidence grounding, audit trail, EOR onboarding.

This project is not affiliated with Remote. It is inspired only by public documentation.
